stories.title: Sequoia shutting down its Scouts program marks the end of an era
stories.summary: Sequoia pioneered the scouts model and many VC firms followed suit, but a consensus now seems to be forming that the model has reached limits in its current form.
stories.zh_title: 紅杉資本關閉其童子軍計劃標誌著一個時代的結束
stories.zh_summary: 紅杉資本開創了偵察模式，許多創投公司紛紛效仿，但現在似乎正在形成共識，目前的模式形式已達到極限。

stories.title: Crusoe sells troubled Wyoming data center project to Google
stories.summary: The deal highlights the challenges of developing massive AI data centers.
stories.zh_title: Crusoe將陷入困境的懷俄明州數據中心項目出售給Google
stories.zh_summary: 這筆交易突顯了開發大型AI數據中心的挑戰。

stories.title: Cramer’s week ahead: AI data center stocks face another hurdle and so does the Fed
stories.summary: CoreWeave and Nebius earnings, alongside key inflation reports that could shape the Fed's next interest rate decision, are the focus.
stories.zh_title: 克萊默未來一周：人工智慧資料中心股票面臨另一個障礙，Fed也是如此
stories.zh_summary: CoreWeave 和 Nebius 的收益，以及可能影響聯準會下一次利率決定的關鍵通膨報告，都是焦點。

stories.title: Nvidia, AMD and other chip stocks rebound — but is relief from the ‘violent’ selloff only temporary?
stories.summary: Analysts warn of further volatility ahead, although there are several new factors that work in the AI trade’s favor.
stories.zh_title: 英偉達、AMD 和其他晶片股反彈——但「猛烈」拋售的緩解只是暫時的嗎？
stories.zh_summary: 分析師警告稱，儘管有幾個新因素對人工智慧產業有利，但未來仍將出現進一步波動。

stories.title: Americans are on a 'treadmill of high inflation' and more rate hikes are likely, Fed's Daly says
stories.summary: San Francisco Fed President Mary Daly called Friday's jobs report "good news for American workers," but noted the pressure inflation is exerting on household finances
stories.zh_title: 聯準會戴利表示，美國人正處於「高通膨的跑步機」上，可能會進一步升息
stories.zh_summary: 舊金山聯邦儲備銀行行長瑪麗·戴利稱週五的就業報告“對美國工人來說是個好消息”，但也指出通膨給家庭財務帶來的壓力

stories.title: Meta introduces Spaces, a new way to collaborate with your Muse agent
stories.summary: Meta's Muse agents continue to get new features and integrations. Spaces promises to be a new way to interact with the AI helpers.
stories.zh_title: Meta 推出 Spaces，這是與 Muse 代理程式協作的新方式
stories.zh_summary: Meta 的 Muse 代理程式不斷獲得新功能和整合。 Spaces 有望成為與人工智慧助理互動的新方式。

stories.title: Free Chinese AI Models Are Getting Scary Good at Hacking
stories.summary: An experiment in which AI models were asked to break into simulated networks showed the hacking skills of DeepSeek and GLM to be not far behind OpenAI’s most advanced cyber model, which isn’t public.
stories.zh_title: 免費的中國人工智慧模式在駭客方面的能力越來越強
stories.zh_summary: 一項要求 AI 模型闖入模擬網路的實驗表明，DeepSeek 和 GLM 的駭客技術與 OpenAI 最先進的網路模型（未公開）相差不遠。

stories.title: OpenAI, Arm and Qualcomm executives react to post-midterm AI sell-off
stories.summary: Executives of major tech companies are largely projecting optimism about continued growth in the artificial intelligence sector despite a post-midterm sell-off.
stories.zh_title: OpenAI、Arm 和高通高階主管對中期後人工智慧拋售的反應
stories.zh_summary: 儘管中期後遭遇拋售，但主要科技公司的高階主管大多對人工智慧產業的持續成長表示樂觀。

stories.title: Data centers run on debt. That was a problem for bonds this year — and it’s only going to get worse.
stories.summary: AI debt issuance this year overwhelmed investor portfolios, and has disappointed from a performance perspective. The funding need won’t get any better with Democrats in control of Congress.
stories.zh_title: 資料中心負債累累。這是今年債券面臨的問題，而且只會變得更糟。
stories.zh_summary: 今年的人工智慧債券發行讓投資人投資組合不堪重負，從業績角度來看也令人失望。隨著民主黨控制國會，資金需求不會有任何改善。

stories.title: Investors brace for lower Anthropic valuation, calling $1.5 trillion a 'stretch'
stories.summary: Anthropic could list below a $1.5 trillion valuation, trailing previous expectations, as the AI trade sours on Wall Street.
stories.zh_title: 投資者為 Anthropic 估值下降做好準備，稱 1.5 兆美元“過高”
stories.zh_summary: 隨著華爾街人工智慧交易的惡化，Anthropic 的估值可能會低於 1.5 兆美元，落後於先前的預期。

stories.title: Micron’s stock is dirt cheap — and that’s igniting a fierce online debate
stories.summary: Valuation purists see a ridiculously inexpensive stock, but some semiconductor investors say Micron’s earnings power won’t hold up.
stories.zh_title: 美光科技的股票非常便宜——這在網路上引發了激烈的爭論
stories.zh_summary: 估值純粹主義者認為這檔股票便宜得離譜，但一些半導體投資者表示，美光的獲利能力無法維持。

stories.title: AI stocks hammered by midterm shock as data center buildout becomes a 'war of attrition'
stories.summary: The election rout landed on an AI trade already under pressure from high interest rates, heavy capital spending and questions about returns.
stories.zh_title: 由於資料中心建設成為“消耗戰”，人工智慧股票受到中期衝擊的打擊
stories.zh_summary: 選舉潰敗降臨到人工智慧產業，該產業已經面臨高利率、巨額資本支出和回報問題的壓力。

stories.title: Ramp data shows AI spending stalling just as Anthropic nears its IPO
stories.summary: AI usage keeps climbing, but spending has stalled. Price cuts and smarter cost controls among the biggest spenders could challenge investor assumptions about AI hypergrowth.
stories.zh_title: 斜坡數據顯示，就在 Anthropic 接近 IPO 之際，人工智慧支出陷入停滯
stories.zh_summary: 人工智慧的使用不斷攀升，但支出卻停滯不前。最大支出者的降價和更明智的成本控制可能會挑戰投資​​者對人工智慧高速成長的假設。

stories.title: My adviser recommended an annuity. Is it the right move in this market environment?
stories.summary: “I haven’t committed to the strategy yet and would appreciate some independent perspectives.”
stories.zh_title: 我的顧問推薦了年金。在這樣的市場環境下，此舉是否正確？
stories.zh_summary: “我還沒有致力於該戰略，希望有一些獨立的觀點。”

stories.title: The AI ‘credit card’ is getting costlier as CoreWeave bond yield tops 16%
stories.summary: Coreweave's steep yields reflect stress in the AI debt markets as investors worry about a data center slowdown. What comes next.
stories.zh_title: CoreWeave 債券殖利率突破 16%，人工智慧「信用卡」成本越來越高
stories.zh_summary: Coreweave 的高收益率反映出人工智慧債務市場面臨的壓力，因為投資者擔心資料中心成長放緩。接下來會發生什麼事。
